crossRefs.note: So Yahweh our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one…
When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we…
We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the…
and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (who was left of the remnant of the Rephaim)…
He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings,
to him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

parallels.note: So Yahweh our God delivered into our hand Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one…

translations.web: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.
translations.bsb: So they struck down Og, along with his sons and his whole army, until no remnant was left. And they took possession of his land.
translations.kjv: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
translations.asv: So they smote him, and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him remaining: and they possessed his land.
